'''3DVO cam droids''' were a series of [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droids]] that were produced during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Characteristics==
The 3DVO came equipped with a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift engine]] for mobility and had a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] for recording. It also had multiple backup recorders and a communications array. It was considered one of the most intelligent cam droids on the market and would often search out scoops on its own volition.<ref name="NEGD" />

==History==
[[3DVO|One 3DVO cam droid]] accompanied [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on a mission to [[Jazbina/Legends|Jazbina]].
